correctness.rationale: The greedy arch factorization yields a complete labelled finite-state recurrence A_j=1+zuE+1_{j<h}zA_{j+1}, E=1+zA_1+1_{h>=2}zA_2. Solving gives F_h=(1+2zS_h+uz^(h+1))/(1-uz²T_h). Positive polynomial supports show all and only n from 2k to (h+1)k+h, plus the exact boundary multiplicities; the h=1 alternating case is separate. For fixed h>=2 the lengths 2 and 3 in z²T_h are coprime, yielding a unique analytic dominant pole; quasi-powers differentiations give the stated mean, variance and Gaussian CLT. A fresh independent brute-force enumeration of all admissible binary words for h=1..4 and n=0..13 confirmed 56 full coefficient rows against the rational formula. These finite tests do not prove the asymptotics.
residual_risks: All-length proof is mathematical, not established by bounded test.
